phases.title: Bootstrap
phases.summary: Detect the project, check MCP, create the feature folder and pass G0.

phases.title: Discover
phases.summary: Trace the feature through the repository and write discovery.md (G1).

phases.title: Specify
phases.summary: Write spec.md and gap-analysis.md with FR/AC, authorization, data volume and UI states.

phases.title: Clarify
phases.summary: Resolve material questions and pass G2.

phases.title: Plan
phases.summary: Write plan.md with MCP-verified component strategy and slices, plus test-scenarios.md (G3).

phases.title: Tasks
phases.summary: Break slices into traceable tasks in tasks.md.

phases.title: Analyze
phases.summary: Check cross-artifact consistency and MCP evidence (G4).

phases.title: Implement
phases.summary: Implement one slice at a time with the MCP loop; pass G5 and G6 per slice.

phases.title: Review
phases.summary: Review against the requirement and checklists; pass G7.

phases.title: Done
phases.summary: Apply the Definition of Done and pass G8.

utilities.title: Status
utilities.summary: Show kit, profile, MCP status and feature state with the next step.

utilities.title: Gate
utilities.summary: Run a quality gate (G0–G8) and report its checks.

utilities.title: Scan
utilities.summary: Run the anti-pattern scanner on changed files and explain findings.
